BlindRoom.title: BlindRoom
BlindRoom.description: Zero-knowledge ephemeral matchmaking room storing only public ECDH keys and session salt. No private keys or plaintext ever touch Firestore.

hostUid.description: Authenticated UID of the host participant.

guestUid.description: Authenticated UID of the guest participant, or empty while waiting.

hostPubKey.description: Base64-encoded X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo ECDH P-256 public key of the host.

guestPubKey.description: Base64-encoded X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo ECDH P-256 public key of the guest.

ephemeralSalt.description: Base64-encoded 256-bit random salt used for HKDF-SHA256 session key derivation.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the ephemeral room.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last room state transition (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BlindEnvelope.title: BlindEnvelope
BlindEnvelope.description: Immutable AES-256-GCM encrypted packet containing message, reply quote, or emoji reaction.

participantUids.description: Bounded list (1..2) of participant UIDs authorized to read/delete this envelope.

ratchetStep.description: Monotonic HKDF-SHA256 ratchet counter used to derive the per-message key.

iv.description: Base64-encoded 96-bit random initialization vector for AES-256-GCM.

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext including 128-bit authentication tag.

ttlSeconds.description: Disappearing message timer in seconds (0, 15, 30, or 60).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when envelope was relayed (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Ephemeral matchmaking rooms storing public ECDH parameters.

/rooms/{roomId}/envelopes/{envelopeId}.description: Encrypted AES-256-GCM envelopes scoped to room participants.
